UpdateSourceArgs: -c "R='{{$FullRootDir}}'; B='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; mkdir -p \"$B\" || exit 1; for d in server database; do [ -d \"$R$d\" ] || continue; if [ -n \"$(ls -A \"$B$d\" 2>/dev/null)\" ]; then echo \"WARNING: $R$d and $B$d both exist; using $B$d, $R$d is left as it is\"; else rmdir \"$B$d\" 2>/dev/null; mv \"$R$d\" \"$B$d\" && echo \"Moved $d/ into instance/\" || exit 1; fi; done"

-c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && echo 'Downloading {{ServerTarballURL}}' && wget -nv -O star-conflict-server.tar.gz '{{ServerTarballURL}}' || { echo 'Server tarball download failed. Aborting'; rm -f star-conflict-server.tar.gz; exit 1; }"

-c "S='{{$FullRootDir}}212070'; D='{{$FullBaseDir}}server'; [ -d \"$S/steamapps\" ] || exit 0; mkdir -p \"$D\" && cp -al --remove-destination \"$S/.\" \"$D/\" && rm -rf \"$S\" && echo 'Moved the Steam install from 212070/ into server/'"
